title: Windows Hopper keyboard shortcut does not work in Rider.

status.label: Application-specific Window Hopper bug
status.detail: Multiple Rider windows produce no Window Hopper thumbnails while the same shortcut works in other applications.

next_action.label: Design Rider window-enumeration fix
next_action.reason: The application boundary and expected comparison are clear enough for targeted investigation.

actions.label: Design Rider support fix
actions.note: Compare Window Hopper enumeration and grouping for multiple Rider windows against applications that work, then define an application-specific regression test. This drafts no upstream mutation.

judgment.rationale: The report isolates the failure to Rider and confirms the configured shortcut works with other applications.
evidence: The reporter opens multiple Rider windows and invokes Window Hopper.
No window thumbnails appear for Rider.
The same feature and tested shortcuts work in other applications on PowerToys 0.101.2362.
judgment.recommended_action: Investigate how Window Hopper enumerates or groups Rider top-level windows and design a focused compatibility test.
